Rae: quick note - ran Petal customer LoRA (petal-lora-v2) on int4 quick-eval. Seeing formatting jitter and one truncation in long receipt prompt.

Devin: paste command + top fails pls.

Rae: cmd:
./bench/run_quick_eval --model petal-lora-v2 --quant=int4 --prompts=customers/petal/smoke.json --out=/tmp/petal.json --batch=8
Summary: pass 46/60, numeric_integrity 0.84 vs float16 0.99.

Rae: failures (redacted): id4: "€1.200,50" -> "€1.200," (missing cents), id11: "3.14" -> "3 .14", id27: long receipt truncated mid-line at ~130 tokens.

Arjun: sounds like output-proj scaling under int4. Did you force same tokenizer/merges and detokenize config?

Rae: yes. Tried bias-correction toggle, no change.

Devin: can you attach a tiny repro and KV around the truncation point?

Rae: repro snippet: "Receipt:
Line1: total=€1.200,50
Line2: total=€2.300,75
Q: sum totals" -> model stops after first line. KV excerpt shows dp drop at the token before second euro sign.

Arjun: try enabling per-channel rescale on quantization and re-run.

Rae: enabling per-channel rescale -> numeric_integrity 0.96, pass 57/60, truncation fixed on repro. Perf hit ~+4% at 1024 context.

Nina: ok capture perf numbers and open profile PR recommending "int4+per-channel-rescale" for petal-lora-v2.

Devin: good. If full quickpack holds we'll mark it int4-compatible-with-rescale and notify Petal.
